newsitem.title: USA: Nextel adds eight cities to network.
newsitem.headline: Nextel adds eight cities to network.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc on Monday said it launched digital wireless networks in Los Angeles, New York, Washington D.C., San Diego, St Louis, Seattle, Portland and Baltimore.
This brings to 200 the U.S. cities covered by the company. Last week it launched service in North Carolina cities Charlotte, Raleigh/Durham and Greensboro/Winston Salem.
"By the end of 1998, Nextel plans to cover areas where 85 percent of America's population live or work," said chief executive Dan Akerson.
